text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My name is Seeking the Pearl! A presence 
who gives dreams to people around the 
world and saves them from despair!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you, everyone!! Consecutive wins 
back home, and then—the moment we achieve 
Tracen Academy's very first European GⅠ 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, you gotta choose between the 
Sprint/Mile route or the Triple Tiara! If 
you're going for the Sprint/Mile route—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The massive wall standing in our way is 
Taiki Shuttle! But the stronger the 
opponent, the more burning my passion 
gets!
